messages:
rachel (Support): FYI, enterprise customer 'NovaHealth' opened a ticket requesting streaming chat that can trigger function/tool calls mid-response and emit structured JSON payloads as they stream. They need tail latency <200ms and must be able to invoke a tool immediately when the model decides to. Customer onboarding scheduled in ~6 weeks. Ticket: https://support.example.com/t/9882
sam (Sales): They said they'd move forward if we can deliver in that timeframe. Rough ARR attached to the opportunity. Need a quick scope/estimate so we can set expectations.
maya (PM): Thanks — can you paste the specific example from the ticket? Is this essentially streamed tokens + mid-stream tool invocation + structured output schema enforcement?
rachel (Support): Exact ask: model should stream partial tokens, then emit a tool call event with JSON args, the customer's service will respond, and the model should resume streaming the rest of the response. Right now their workaround is non-streaming completions and an out-of-band tool call, which is too slow for their UX.
sophia (Eng): Engineering note: our current streaming surface supports token-by-token streaming and a single function-call final payload, but not interleaved tool payloads mid-stream. To support this we need changes in the runtime to emit discrete 'event' frames (tool_call_start / payload / end) and allow the session to pause/resume KV cache handling. This touches the transport framing and runtime scheduling.
adrian (SRE): Operational concerns: if a stream blocks waiting for an external tool, we need connection backpressure, timeouts, and limits on concurrent in-flight tool calls or it will impact GPU utilization.
maya (PM): Proposal for scope: define a new streaming event packet type in the API contract: event: tool_call_start | tool_call_payload | tool_call_end | structured_chunk. Launch criteria: 1) API contract doc + examples, 2) SDK changes for node/python and tests, 3) E2E sample plugin demonstrating round-trip, 4) perf regression <=5% p95 token tail at typical load, 5) migration/compatibility guide. Priority: P1 for Dedicated/Enterprise customers, opt-in for hosted.
sophia (Eng): Ballpark eng work: ~12 engineer-weeks to spec and runtime plumbing, plus ~4 weeks for SDKs and canary. Unknowns: protocol bump for streaming clients, and edge SDKs may need minor changes.
sam (Sales): Can we gate feature by account flag so Dedicated/enterprise can opt in and hosted defaults off until stable? Sales needs explicit compatibility language for customers.
maya (PM): Yes — rollout plan: feature flagged per-account. Dedicated: enable via config. Hosted: opt-in beta with telemetry. Fallback behavior: if tool invocation fails, stream emits an error event and the model can fall back to finishing the response non-streamed.
rachel (Support): Acceptance tests we should require: 1) round-trip with a mock tool that echoes input, 2) verify event ordering and that partial JSON chunks are not corrupted in downstream consumers, 3) logs surface session ids and event types for troubleshooting.
sophia (Eng): Also recommend adding structured schema validation: customers can provide a JSON schema for tool args; runtime validates and emits schema_violation events. That adds ~1 week.
maya (PM): Decision: add to roadmap as "Streaming tool-call events + structured streaming output" and tentatively target next quarter. Action items: @sophia create RFC draft by 1987654400, @adrian document infra constraints and backpressure requirements by 1987654500, @rachel collect two additional customer tickets for pattern validation, @sam confirm ARR impact. I'll open a backlog ticket linking this thread.
sophia (Eng): Will do — I'll include protocol examples using JSON-lines framing and an SSE-like event envelope. Example sketch: ```event: tool_call_payload
data: {"name": "lookup_med","args": {"patient_id": "1234"}}
```
adrian (SRE): Ops flag: add a 30s default circuit breaker for external tool calls, metrics for in-flight tool calls, and alerts on queue growth.
sam (Sales): I'll tell the customer we can prioritize but can't promise a ship date until we have the RFC + infra estimate.
rachel (Support): I'll reply to the customer with the opt-in plan and ask for sandbox credentials for their tool so we can E2E test.
roadie-bot (triage): Created ticket PROD-6729 and linked this thread.
